intent: Review the buffered C7/UCC27624 sensitivity experiment, its asymmetric GatePath extension, source-bound 2,916-case report, two legacy controls, and retained evidence. Numerical results are conditional piecewise-linear sensitivity only; physical/interface qualification remains intentionally indeterminate.

findings.title: Independent audit accepts 2,916 copies of one case
findings.suggested_fix: Bind each TSV row to the canonical scenario key and require the exact 2,916-key Cartesian set, rejecting duplicates, missing keys, and out-of-grid rows before accepting the arithmetic audit.
findings.why_it_matters: The audit checks each row's closed-form arithmetic but never checks row identity, device/profile/grid membership, uniqueness, or correspondence to the source-bound report. Repeating one valid row 2,916 times therefore produces a passing cases=2916 receipt without covering the Cartesian experiment.
evidence: zapote/power-entry/loss-budget/options/experiment-02/independent-audit.rs:54-68 -- audit_row validates only 22 columns and arithmetic values; the first TSV field is used only in an error label.
zapote/power-entry/loss-budget/options/experiment-02/independent-audit.rs:71-80 -- main increments count for every accepted line and emits pass without a key set or duplicate/missing check.
A repeated copy of the first valid audit-input.tsv row 2,916 times would be accepted and emit cases=2916 despite omitting the other scenarios.

findings.title: Persisted report JSON has no corruption validation path
findings.suggested_fix: Add a replay/validation command that deserializes the retained report schema, rechecks report-level identities and scenario relationships, and verifies the source/report digest binding before evidence is accepted.
findings.why_it_matters: The CLI only reads a source manifest, regenerates a report, and prints JSON. It never ingests evidence/report.json, so a retained report can be changed after generation while still being treated as the claimed 2,916-case evidence; the existing mutation tests cover in-memory structs only.
evidence: zapote/packages/zapote-harness/src/bin/zapote-pfc-drive-experiment.rs:6-13 -- the sole input is a source manifest and the command only serializes a freshly generated report.
zapote/packages/zapote-harness/src/pfc_drive_experiment.rs:706 -- validate_scenario_grid is called only on newly generated in-memory scenarios.
zapote/packages/zapote-harness/src/pfc_drive_experiment.rs:800-818 -- corruption tests mutate Rust structs in memory and do not deserialize a serialized evidence artifact.

triage_groups.title: Evidence binding and replay integrity
triage_groups.context: Both findings allow a retained independent or generated artifact to claim complete coverage without proving correspondence to the canonical report.
triage_groups.preferred_resolution: Add canonical-key and serialized-report replay validation before accepting retained evidence.
triage_groups.why: The experiment's numerical checks are only useful when the checked rows and retained report are bound to the exact source and grid.

met: Explicit asymmetric GatePath API with legacy simulate compatibility and applied path serialization
Exact 2,916-case grid, two nominal controls, source hashes, scalar/accounting checks, and mutation coverage
Independent closed-form arithmetic audit retained with raw input/output and source identity
Numerical PASS is separated from physical/interface/qualification INDETERMINATE status
unresolved: Independent audit does not enforce canonical scenario-key coverage
No serialized report replay/corruption validator binds retained evidence to the generated source-bound report

learnings.title: A validator must assert input correspondence, not only output arithmetic
learnings.note: The independent audit needs an exact-key precondition so a green arithmetic result cannot stand in for complete scenario coverage.

learnings.title: A runnable model is evidence only inside its declared boundary
learnings.note: The report correctly keeps physical qualification indeterminate, but retained artifacts still need source and serialization binding.

residual_risks: The piecewise-linear switching model remains conditional; driver dynamic impedance, commutation, overshoot, temperature, supply production, sequencing, and installed assembly qualification are intentionally unmeasured.
No live build or runtime verification was performed in this bounded review; root-owned workspace evidence was inspected as retained artifacts.
testing_gaps: No regression test compares legacy_controls against the retained experiment-01 report bytes inside the new validator; external retained evidence shows matching nominal values.
No serialized report mutation test exercises deserialization and source/report identity checks.

coverage.peer: Cross-model private-code egress was skipped after the prior automatic-approval rejection; no external recipient was authorized.
notes: Scope included tracked Rust/API changes and all experiment-02 source/audit/evidence files requested by the coordinator, including untracked paths.
